g.text: KayaRank1Convo2 begins.
Hi. Why would Entrati's cross-temporal setup involve what appears to be an active connection to the Kinemantik Online Network?
Or, I guess, Hi. Is the internet required for time travel?
Right to it then, okay. No, the ‘internet’ didn’t make it to my time, really, so it can’t be required. Or maybe it is.
And hello to you too, Kaya.
So you do not need an internet connection to come and go as you please? Did Entrati?
Ugh. Internet? I could see how given the properties of a network..
I really don't know anything for sure. I just know there was a sequence, Entrati had a plan, and it involved me, here, now. I needed to get here, to meet you all.
Okay, but why does there seem to be an internet connection that is non-negotiable in some of his notes?
I'll ask him next time I see him.
You have his notes?
Is that a problem? Wouldn't a kid like you love the internet?
Not literally. Just what I saw when I found him. I don't think he expected to be found.
Check boolean KayaSetKid
Sorry, was making a joke... They have those in the future.
A joke. Lighten up.
Update boolean KayaSetFound
Does it make you feel better to keep calling me a kid? Like, don't you get it?
true
You don't know anything about me.
false
Fine.
No.
YOU? You found Entrati, when no one else could?
You found him? How?
I had to grow up FAST. The people on this f**** internet made sure of that.
+20 Chemistry
+20 Chemistry
+20 Chemistry
I wanted answers.
+20 Chemistry
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank1Convo3.
And you're sure there's not internet in your future? Like totally sure?
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank1Convo3.
+20 Chemistry
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank1Convo3.
Actually, forget I said anything. I'll find out when I get there.
Things changed too fast in this shithole. Especially in the internet backrooms talking about this Doktor.
+20 Chemistry
So I found him, surprised him. And ohh my god. Grandpa Doktor was not happy but, I cut right to it.
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank1Convo3.
I knew he was from the future. He knew I knew. He gave me a choice and well whatever. Now I found you.
And in a way I'm giving you a choice too. Help me, or regret it.
Charming. I'm not your enemy you know.
Do you threaten all your new friends?
Not yet anyway. People change. Guess we'll see.
Just protecting myself.
+20 Chemistry
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank1Convo3.
